none: PAS NLM-6877F0: Early Medieval Coin: Penny of Ethelraed II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. A chipped Penny of Aethelred II (978-1016), as kindly identified by the finder with reference to North no. 766 and Spink (nd - 2004 consulted by this reporter) no. 1144, issue of 979-985. About one quarter of flan is lost. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Initial cross pattee. Obverse inscription: +EDELREDREXA(--). Reverse description: Hand (North hand 1)…
